get_neighbors: find k nearest neighbors between two sets of embedding vectors using FAISS IVF index
find_similar_texts_ids: find hard negative text pairs with high similarity using a SentenceTransformer encoder
get_contrastive_sample: sample positive and negative pairs from embeddings for contrastive training batches
ranking_loss: compute a hinge-like ranking loss with L2 regularization on model predictions
combined_training: train a comparator model with mixed supervised regression and contrastive loss objectives
